ValidationRule.description: Requires campaign attribution once a voucher enters the active homeowner funnel.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Submitted'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Validated'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Reserved'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Applied to Quote'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Contract Signed'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Deposit Paid'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Builder Invoice Pending'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Builder Invoiced'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Paid by Builder'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Redeemed') ), ISBLANK(Campaign__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Campaign is required once a voucher enters the submitted funnel.
